items.title: Alterac Valley Adjustments in WoW: Forever - November 25
items.summary: Alterac Valley Adjustments in WoW: Forever - November 25 Originally Posted by Blizzard ( Blue Tracker / Official Forums ) We’ve seen that players in Alterac Valley were frequently completing the battleground without capturing the objectives, so we’ve made some adjustments to incentivize a focus on the objectives rather than rushing to kill the enemy faction’s General. The intent with these adjustments is for Honor gains to be relatively the same and reputation to be increased per match. Additionally, the difficulty of enemy creatures inside Alterac Valley has been lower than intended, so we’ve increased that, and we’ve made some adjustments to how the Warmasters/Marshals and Faction Generals behave to improve their sturdiness. Player versus Player Alterac Valley Reputation and Honor from killing the enemy faction General has been significantly reduced. The reputation from objectives (Towers, Graveyards, and Mines) has been increased to compensate. Honor from these objectives has been slightly increased as a redistribution. Reputation from killing enemy NPCs has been increased. Damage and Health has been increased for all enemy creatures in Alterac Valley. Warmasters/Marshals will now leash if they leave their respective rooms, and they now aggro from further away. Generals and Warmasters/Marshals all are stronger if the objectives are present. This buff lasts for 20 minutes and

Moon and Stars also grants Starfire a 50/100% chance not lose casting time when the Druid takes damage. Improved Starfire reduced from to 2 points (was 5 points), and now grants 8/15% chance with 1/2 talent points. Druids with 3 or more points spent in this talent will have all their talent points reset and unspent. Eclipse now also increases the critical strike chance of Wrath by 7/13/20% at all times. Moonfury talent removed and replaced with Dreamstate. Dreamstate grants the Druid 20/40/60/80/100% of the benefit of Innervate when casting Innervate on a target other than self. Moonkin Form now also increases Arcane and Nature damage done by 10% while in that form. Prisoners march under close guard, strangers smile with an eerie conviction, and an uncomfortable silence provides cover for a growing threat. As she plays along to get closer to the truth, she finds herself overwhelmed by hidden agendas and fanatic devotion. And in a land ruled by wind, blind devotion can become a storm.
